content: Adam duratni-waitni
Hadi de Adam duratni-waitni horatni-hairni. Lerni pa Orgahi-Orha'a Na'ohi-na'ara rimormior die, de Nhi'a pa nal emolmolan neka E'a.
Na'ohi-na'ara hare de, muanke'a me patke'a. Nara'a-napalga rpa ra'upa-ra'a'na, ne Nal nanni rpa rwawa rimormiori, la'a lera Ha Na'ohi-na'ara re.
La'pa Adam nmor niana anni rahu ida terampwotelu dewade, na'a'na nana muanke'a id maka nal emolmolla e'a, noka nala pa nwawa Seta.
La'pa na'a'na nana Seta pa nhorwua noma Adam nmormior mia'ta pa anni rahu wo'awa owa'ana, de na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Adam nte'ela mormiorni anni rahu wosiewa terampwotelu dewade, nmat wia.
La'pa Seta nmor niana anni rahu ida wehrani wolim wa dewade, na'a'na Enos.
Ne Seta nmormior niekpa nahor dioinia anni rahu wo'awa wehrani wo'itu. Na'a'na Enos pa nhorwua dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Seta nte'ela mormiorni anni rahu wosiewa termida wehrani woru, noka nmat wia.
La'pa Enos nmor niana anni terampwosiew pa dewade, na'a'na Kenan.
Ne Enos nmormior mia'ta pa nte' nana anni rahu wo'awa termida wehrani wolima, la'pa na'a'na nan Kenan wa dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Enos nte' nana mormiorni anni rahu wosiewa wehrani wolim wa dewade, nmat wia.
La'pa Kenan nmormior pia nte'ela anni terampwo'it wua dewade, na'a'na nana Mahalaleel.
Ne Kenan nmormior niekpa nte'ela anni rahu wo'awa terampwogata, la'pa na'a'na nana Mahalaleel dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Kenan nte'ela mormiorni anni rahu wosiewa termid wa dewade, nmat wia.
La'pa Mahalaleel nmor niana anni terampwonema wehrani wolim wa dewade, na'a'na nana Yared.
Ne Mahalaleel nmormior niekpa nte'ela anni rahu wo'awa terampwotelu, la'pa na'a'n nan Yared pa nhorwua dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Mahalaleel nte'ela anni rahu wo'awa terampwosiewa wehrani wolim wa dewade, nmat wia.
La'pa Yared nmormior niana anni rahu ida terampwonema wehrani woru, dewade na'a'na Henok.
Ne Yared nmormior niekpa nte'ela anni rahu wo'awa, la'pa na'a'na nan Henok wa dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Yared nmormior pia nte' nana anni rahu wosiewa terampwonema wehrani woru dewade, nmat wia.
La'pa Henok mormiorni anni terampwonema wehrani wolim wa dewade, na'a'na Metusala.
Ne Henok nala' nohora Uplerlawna la'a mormiorni-dardiarni ralamni pa nte' nana anni rahu wotelg owa'ana, la'pa na'a'na nana Metusala pa nhor diewade na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Henok mormiorni nte' nana anni rahu wotelu terampwonema wehrani wolima.
Ne Henok mormiorni de, nala' nohora Uplerlawna, noma edonna nden olek la wa, yoma Uplerlawna Nran doini oleka la nohkeran di wawannu.
La'pa Metusala nmor niana anni rahu ida terampwo'awa wehrani wo'it wua dewade, na'a'na Lamek.
Ne Metusala nmormior mia'ta pa nte' nana anni rahu wo'itu, terampwo'awa wehrani woru, la'pa na'a'na Lamek pa nhorwua dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Metusala mormiorni la nte' nana anni rahu wosiewa terampwonema wehrani wosiew wa dewade, nmat wia.
La'pa Lamek nmor niana anni rahu ida terampwo'awa wehrani woru, dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a ida.

Noma nal nanni pa nwawa Nuh, yoma niwra: “Keke'en di hota nala ralam yahepru mai ita la' ita tulanni-kniarni, maka penpuenu-nanah nohora mehrani-maunu la tan miaka Orgahi Nhi'a pa nhoptutu-nhopler de.”
Ne Lamek nmormior mia'ta pa nte' nana anni rahu wolima terampwosiewa wehrani wolima, la'pa na'a'na nan Nuh dewade, na'a'n owa'ana muanke'a me patke'a.
Pede Lamek mormiorni nte' nana anni rahu wo'itu terampwo'itu wehrani wo'itu wa dewade, nmat wia.
La'pa Nuh nmor niana anni rahu wolim wa de, na'a'na Sema, Yafeta me Ham.
